body.purpose: Field values, list content, button labels.

label.purpose: Field labels and secondary metadata, set in Ink Muted.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width solid action button, 56px height, used for the single primary action on a screen.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">บันทึกข้อมูลเข้าสู่ระบบ</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; height: 56px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: #2f6fc4; color: #ffffff; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3a7bd6; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fb0e8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #272a30; color: #80848d; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Toggle Choice Button
components.description: Binary on/off selector (machine picker, QC pass/fail) — full fill swap on active state, no partial hover tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-toggle { flex: 1; height: 48px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; border: 0.5px solid #4a4e57; background: #272a30; color: #f2f3f5; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-toggle--on { background: #2f6fc4; border-color: #2f6fc4; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fb0e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Standard text/number field — recessed one tone below its card, 48px height to avoid mobile auto-zoom.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #a9adb6; margin-bottom: 5px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 0.5px solid #4a4e57; background: #16181d; color: #f2f3f5; font-size: 16px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fb0e8; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field-input[readonly] { background: #272a30; color: #a9adb6; }

components.name: Card / Section
components.description: The primary content grouping surface — flat, tonal, hairline-bordered.
components.html:
ข้อมูลทั่วไป
เนื้อหาภายในการ์ด
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1d1f24; border: 0.5px solid #3a3e46; border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; } .ds-card-head { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #f2f3f5; margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 15px; color: #a9adb6; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Box
components.description: Full-width tinted banner for confirm/warn/alert feedback — the signature component of the system, entirely background-tinted so it reads peripherally.
components.html: ⚠ พักเครื่อง 2 ชม. 15 นาที — เกิน 2 ชม. ตรวจสอบอีกครั้ง
components.css: .ds-status { margin-top: 11px; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-status--confirm { background: #243a2e; color: #7fd1a0; } .ds-status--warn { background: #3a3322; color: #f0c674; } .ds-status--alert { background: #3d2626; color: #e89a9a; }

narrative.overview: This is a logbook, not a storefront. Every screen exists to get one shift's production data recorded correctly, fast, on a shared device that's been tapped with dirty hands since 6am. Nothing here is decorative — the graphite surfaces, the hairline borders, the three-tier status system all exist to answer one question at a glance: did this save, and is anything wrong. The system rejects the two easy failure modes for a tool like this: looking like an abandoned spreadsheet with form fields bolted on, and looking like a consumer app performing friendliness it doesn't need. It is quiet by default and only raises its voice — amber, then rose — when something genuinely needs a second look. Density is generous, not tight: full-width 48–56px touch targets, one clear field per row on narrow layouts, because the cost of a mistap on the floor is a wrong production number, not a mild annoyance.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black graphite base with two tonal surface steps, never a pure black or pure white
Single accent hue (Shift Blue) reserved for primary actions and active/selected state
Three explicit status tiers — confirm, warning, alert — used consistently everywhere
Flat throughout: no shadows, gradients, or glassmorphism; depth via tone-stepping and 0.5px hairlines only
One typeface, one weight scale, no display-size heroics

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Shift Blue is the only color that means "act on this." It never appears as decoration — only on the primary button, the active toggle, and the current selection.

rules.name: The Earned Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber Warning appears only for a real anomaly the operator should double-check. It is never used as a generic "heads up" or an empty-state color.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Geist Sans, everywhere, no exceptions. The checkout screen's Segoe UI override is a defect to fix, not a second typeface to keep.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every border in the system is 0.5px. Never thicker, never a colored accent stripe. If a boundary needs more emphasis, that's a background-tone problem, not a border-weight problem.

dos: Do reserve Shift Blue strictly for primary actions and current selection
Do use the three-tier confirm/warn/alert system for every status message across the whole app
Do keep every tappable control at ≥48px height
Do carry Geist Sans everywhere; retire the Segoe UI override in checkout
Do make read-only fields visually distinct (Graphite Surface 2) rather than identical to editable ones
donts: Don't let this read as a digitized paper form or a spreadsheet with a UI bolted on
Don't add box-shadow, glassmorphism, or gradients anywhere
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe as a decorative accent
Don't spend Amber Warning on anything that isn't a genuine anomaly
Don't introduce a second typeface, a second border weight, or a one-off shadow
